page_title: OSA 3-2 GET | Osasuna v Getafe 21/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+8' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+5' Jose Angel Carmona (Getafe) shouldn't be surprised it's a yellow from the ref, who cooled the situation down well.
90+5' A pass by Djene (Getafe) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.

90+4' Getafe slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
90' The fourth official shows 7 min. of added time.
89' Juan Cruz (Osasuna) has to be very careful for the rest of the match after receiving a yellow card from the referee for a bad tackle on an opponent.
86' The referee signals a substitution. Lucas Torro (Osasuna) is brought on as a substitute for Iker Munoz.
86' Omar Alderete (Getafe) fires a shot at goal from a very promising position outside the penalty area, but it is blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
86' Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
80' 3 - 2 It’s a GOAL! It looked impossible to score from that angle, but Jesus Areso (Osasuna) somehow finds the net from range with a cheeky shot past a flummoxed keeper.
77' Although Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) is just on the bench, Jose Sanchez has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
76' David Garcia (Osasuna) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
73' Jagoba Arrasate prepares a substitution. Raul Garcia is replaced by Jose Manuel Arnaiz (Osasuna).
73' Substitution. Ruben Pena did his best and is replaced by Jesus Areso (Osasuna).
73' A loose ball is pounced on by Jordi (Getafe) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Sergio Herrera is alert and makes a comfortable save.
72' The corner is swung in but Osasuna can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
70' A goal, which was scored by Enes Unal (Getafe), was disallowed due to offside.

68' 2 - 2 Nemanja Maksimovic (Getafe) outjumps the defence inside the six-yard box to meet the corner and scores with a great header into the right side of the goal. The keeper had no chance to react. The score is now 2:2.
68' Corner kick. Luis Milla (Getafe) is ready to send the ball into the box.
66' Substitution. Aimar Oroz (Osasuna) receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Moi Gomez walks off.
66' Jagoba Arrasate decides to make a substitution. Pablo Ibanez will be replaced by Darko Brasanac (Osasuna).
64' 2 - 1 Borja Mayoral (Getafe) meets a perfect cross from Enes Unal deep inside the box and controls it with a nice first touch. He produces an accurate strike into the top right corner. It's 2:1.

63' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) sets himself up and has a crack at goal from the edge of the box. The shot heads low to the middle of the goal, but Sergio Herrera tracks it all the way and makes an easy save.
62' Diego Rico (Getafe) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit cross to the back post.
58' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.

57' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the bottom right corner, but Sergio Herrera easily deals with the threat. Getafe have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
56' Raul Garcia (Osasuna) leaps highest to meet a cross and steers a header towards the right post, but the goalkeeper produces a crucial save to thwart the effort.
52' The ball is cleared after Johan Mojica (Osasuna) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Getafe comes to nothing.
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Carles Alena (Getafe) is replaced by Jose Angel Carmona.
46' Jose Bordalas Jimenez makes a half-time substitution. Jordi comes on in place of Gaston Alvarez (Getafe).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) tries to find Enes Unal, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.

44' Well-positioned Mason Greenwood (Getafe) was first to the rebound and fired in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Sergio Herrera reacted superbly to keep the ball out. The fans could not believe their eyes. It was a miraculous stop!
42' The up-to-date shots on target statistics – 3:0.
39' What was Luis Milla (Getafe) thinking? He will not get away with that. The referee shows him a yellow card.

37' Pablo Ibanez (Osasuna) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by David Soria!
31' 2 - 0 Absolutely fantastic goal! Iker Munoz (Osasuna) hits a perfect volley from far out and the ball flies into the top left corner. Take a bow.
30' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Sergio Herrera, who smothers the ball.
29' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
26' Raul (Osasuna) receives a yellow card from the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
23' Luis Milla (Getafe) takes a short corner kick.
23' Mason Greenwood (Getafe) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
20' Enes Unal (Getafe) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
18' Moi Gomez (Osasuna) will take the free kick.
16' The referee blows his whistle as Carles Alena (Getafe) was too aggressive in his challenge.
12' Some neat passing and movement from Getafe as they ping around some short passes in order to create a new attacking opportunity.
9' 1 - 0 It's in the back of the net! Pablo Ibanez plays it into the box, and Raul (Osasuna) gets on the end of the cross to put it low into the middle of the net. 1:0.
9' Alejandro Catena (Osasuna) attempts to send a defence-splitting pass in order to find free space for his teammate.
7' Raul (Osasuna) is caught offside, but it was a really close call.
6' Ante Budimir (Osasuna) tested David Soria with a strike from just outside the box, but the effort is saved.
6' Borja Mayoral (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
3' Djene (Getafe) sends in a pass which fails to reach any of his teammates.
1' The match has just started.
Getafe will kick the game off.
Today's referee will be Jose Sanchez.
